acip: MA GRUB NA, DER THAL, KHYOD DNGOS PO DANG THA DAD GANG ZHIG, KHYOD KYANG YIN DNGOS PO YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, der thal, khyod dngos po dang tha dad gang zhig, khyod kyang yin dngos po yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that the exclusion of all that is not an unchanging thing is something which is such that being it is contradictory to being a working thing.] Suppose you say it's not correct. It is so correct, Because (1) it [the exclusion of all that is not an unchanging thing] is something distinct from a working thing, and (2) there exists no one thing which is both it [the exclusion of all that is not an unchanging thing] and a working thing.
